issue.title: Fix rule detection and execution order when declared using methods

repository.name: junit-framework
repository.description: ✅ The programmer-friendly testing framework for Java and the JVM

issue.body:
## Overview

`@EnableRuleMigrationSupport` failed to recognize `@Rule` methods that returned a subtype of one of the supported `TestRule` types. Moreover, it mistakenly instantiated some rules declared using methods multiple times. Now, once enabled, it will instantiate all declared rules (fields _and_ methods) exactly once and call them in the same order used by Vintage.

Executing `RuleJUnit5Test` from #1128 now yields

```
ExampleExternalResourceRule init
ExternalResource init
TestRule init
TestRule before
ExternalResource before
ExampleExternalResourceRule before
ExampleExternalResourceRule after
ExternalResource after
TestRule after
```

which matches the output from `RuleJUnit4Test`

```
ExampleExternalResourceRule init
ExternalResource init
TestRule init
TestRule before
ExternalResource before
ExampleExternalResourceRule before
ExampleExternalResourceRule after
ExternalResource after
TestRule after
```
